objective:
Goal: a menu for choosing a time period is open. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "Optionally, to view contributors during a specific time period, to the right of "Contributors," click Period: All.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, store the main heading of the page you end on as 'landed_on', then verify the goal on screen.

actions.instr: Clicking Contributors link in Insights sidebar

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Click through the visible UI by any route to open a menu for choosing a time period; role=button; text="Period: Last 3 months" | HINTS: container=Contributors main content, beside Contributions filter
actions.instr: Clicking the period dropdown to choose a time range
